C1082.title: Manling Porridge Shop Fined for Kitchen Hygiene Violations
C1082.summary: In 2022, Manling Porridge Shop in Fuding City, Fujian, was ordered to rectify issues including failure to regularly clean and maintain kitchen equipment and failure to promptly clean utensils after use.
